fragmentReservationR2.observed5aEvidenceAsDocumented: 5A records fourteen terminal fragments created earlier in B through linked_temporal_preparation.phase.masks, then created by A through common reasoning transitions: three in STCK measured and eleven in SMLP measured, none in warmups. This review read their documented inventory and qualifier source, not the capture archives.
fragmentReservationR2.fiveAClosedRule: The distinct premeasurement supplement and v2 qualifier bind the retained failure, exact captures and closed identities. They require complete equal fragment values and addresses, exact real causes and creation deltas, owner-only earlier consumers and complete equal common consumer roots at catch-up. Monotone E counts actual attributed B deltas and C counts explicitly matched A creations; revisionB minus revisionA must equal E minus C. Historical deltas are not rewritten.
fragmentReservationR2.symbolsAssessment: First-creator sharing is generic to the content-addressed store, so the mechanism cannot be dismissed for an arbitrary populated Symbols history. The specific 5A passive matrix mechanism is absent: Symbols acquires scenes, contrasts and methods only from its selected returns. Cold unselected proposals mainly change scope epochs. Furthermore, admissible A/B work shapes compare family and proposalKind exactly and baseline has no Symbols owner, so a Symbols selection would already violate those work constraints. These source observations reduce the expected route to R2 but are not a proof about future integrated frozen captures.
fragmentReservationR2.currentRefusal: The unchanged 7B qualifier recomputes extra-node categories per point but keeps a cumulative B-only attribution count. An extra fragment becoming common can fail common origin, common delta or cumulative revision equality. This is a closed refusal, not a silent acceptance.
fragmentReservationR2.decision: Do not import the fourteen identities, phase.masks rule or E-minus-C accounting into 7B now. Examine the actual final frozen graphs before contract and measurement. Preserve any failed qualification and review any required distinct attribution rule before the window.
